# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report vulnerabilities privately through [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/security/advisories/new). Please do not open a public issue, discussion, or pull request to report a vulnerability.

## What to include

Include the affected version or commit, the browser and environment, and the smallest steps that reproduce the problem.

## Supported versions

Fixes ship in the next release of the current release line. There is no long-term-support branch.

## Scope

This policy covers the Neo.mjs engine in this repository. Report vulnerabilities in other repositories of the organization through those repositories' reporting channels.
